responsibility: Target-parameter query layer exported from GCC to the Ada front end. It provides simple accessor functions for machine-dependent scalar sizes, pointer size, endian properties, strict-alignment behavior, and Ada-relevant alignment limits such as maximum default, allocator, and object-file alignment, plus special cases for wide characters and double-word alignment quirks on particular targets. Its job is to let Ada semantic/runtime code obtain stable target C/ABI type characteristics without directly depending on GCC target macros.
